# appgatesdp_appliance_seed (Data Source)

Exports the JSON seed used to activate an inactive appliance.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `appliance_id` (String) ID of the inactive appliance.

### Optional

- `allow_customization` (Boolean) Whether the appliance allows customizations. Defaults to true.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password of the appliance's cz user.
- `provide_cloud_ssh_key` (Boolean) Use the SSH key provided by the cloud platform (AWS, Azure).
- `ssh_key` (String) SSH public key allowed to log in as cz.
- `validity_days` (Number) How many days the seed is valid. Defaults to 1.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as appliance_id.
- `seed_file` (String, Sensitive) Base64 encoded seed JSON; empty when the appliance is already activated.
